title: Marina's Beloved Corvette
subtitle: 1986 C4 Corvette Custom Styling & Treatment Study
summary: A multi-treatment styling exploration centered around a 1986 C4 Corvette, pairing the Sakura Vette custom livery with multi-angle treatment compositions featuring Mina.

title: The Necromancer Series
subtitle: Cyber-JDM Street Brawlers & Character Portrait
summary: A narrative styling study featuring the Necromancer Z as the hero build alongside the Necromancer Skyline and realistic character portrait.

title: 1960 Chrysler Saratoga
subtitle: Swamp Bronze Paint & Stance Color Study
summary: A focused paint and color match study evaluating deep, metallic Swamp Bronze paint formulation against the long-roof body lines of a 1960 Chrysler Saratoga.
narrative: Created as an explicit paint formulation study to evaluate and match the rich, multi-stage reflections of metallic Swamp Bronze.
The sweeping fins and broad flanks of the 1960 Chrysler Saratoga serve as the canvas for assessing color depth under varying ambient lighting conditions.

gallery.caption: 1960 Chrysler Saratoga — Swamp Bronze paint depth and reflection study.

title: Night Wraith: '65 Cadillac Convertible
subtitle: Slammed Air Ride & Comfort Cruiser
summary: A 1965 Cadillac Convertible custom cruiser engineered with a custom bagged air suspension setup to lay frame while effortlessly clearing speed bumps, featuring additional short rear-hinged suicide doors on each side.

specifications.suspension: Custom Full-Range Air Ride (Lays frame & negotiates speed bumps)
specifications.doors: Re-Engineered Custom Short Rear Suicide Doors

narrative: Night Wraith captures the essence of classic South Bay boulevard cruising in a 1965 Cadillac Convertible silhouette.
Built strictly for comfort, presence, and smooth street performance, the body features re-engineered short suicide doors added behind the front doors on each side for refined passenger ingress.

The custom air ride chassis is engineered for full travel flexibility—allowing the massive land yacht to lay complete frame at park while lifting on command to clear steep driveways and speed bumps with ease.

gallery.caption: Night Wraith — Primary stance profile showcasing slammed frame geometry and custom body lines.
Night Wraith — Full ride height and air-bag travel comparison study.
